text: I feel a sense of anticipation and curiosity. The countdown echoes like a prelude to something important. Outside the glass-walled meeting room, I sense the buzz of preparation or discovery—perhaps a presentation or experiment is about to begin. Moving to the vibrant R+D display, I am inspired by the possibilities of research and innovation, my mind alight with questions about how we shape the future with knowledge and technology. I feel alert, intrigued, and open to what unfolds next.
